programme.title: Dance Passion Swansea
programme.desc: Dancers of all kinds take over Swansea's streets, landmarks, parks and beaches to showcase the city, explore what home means and celebrate the life-enhancing joy of dance. There are solos, duets and ensembles. From ballet, Latin and contemporary to ballroom, breaking, traditional clog and Welsh folk dance. Locations range from Mumbles Pier and skateboard park to Swansea Bay and the dunes, beaches and bays of the Gower peninsula.

programme.title: Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Exploring astonishing wild places and the most spectacular moments from the series. In the planet's oldest desert, a pair of ostriches raise their family in the searing heat to keep them safe from predators, but time is ticking.

programme.title: Life on Earth
programme.desc: The story of life, from the first primitive cells to the plants and animals that now live around us. David Attenborough goes on a world journey looking at the incredible variety of living things and fossils which throw light on the ancestry of life.

programme.title: Life on Air: David Attenborough's 50 Years in Television
programme.desc: David Attenborough is one of Britain's best-known TV personalities, having presented programmes - usually about animals or natural history - for decades. Actor Michael Palin presents this special that takes a look back at the TV legend's career, using classic clips, outtakes and anecdotes to highlight Attenborough's work. `Life on Air' also interviews Attenborough and some key figures in his life, including his brother, actor Richard Attenborough. David also welcomes viewers into his home and on the set as he works on one of his programmes.

programme.title: Lost Cities of The Ancients
programme.desc: This is the story of the formidable Hittites and their long-lost capital, Hattusha, which has recently been rediscovered. Buried in this lost city is one of the greatest libraries of the ancient world, and all the secrets of this mysterious civilisation were written in two codes - one a unique form of hieroglyphs with which we can recreate the lost world of the Hittites.

programme.title: Art of Scandinavia
programme.desc: Andrew looks at the extraordinary art to come out of the dark Norwegian soul, most famous for producing The Scream by Edvard Munch.

programme.title: The Sky at Night
programme.sub-title: Jodrell Bank: Tuning Into the Universe
programme.desc: The team explore the remarkable story of Jodrell Bank Observatory and its towering Lovell Telescope, which scientists have used to listen to the cosmos for almost 70 years.

programme.title: British Art at War: Bomberg, Sickert and Nash
programme.sub-title: David Bomberg: Prophet in No Man's Land
programme.desc: Andrew Graham-Dixon examines how the art of David Bomberg was influenced by his experiences during World War One.

programme.title: Art That Made Us
programme.desc: Charting the decisive shift of power from countryside to the city during the 19th century. With the industrial revolution transforming the British Isles, a divide opened up between city and country, forcing artists to respond to the upheaval to lives and the landscape. Some artists attempt to capture the poverty and squalor caused by the rapid urbanisation around them.

programme.title: An Art Lovers' Guide
programme.desc: Janina Ramirez and Alastair Sooke head to Lisbon, rapidly becoming one of Europe's most popular tourist destinations. Winding through the city's cobbled streets, from its steep hills to the picturesque shoreline, the cultural riches they encounter reveal the city's fascinating history.

programme.title: A History of Britain by Simon Schama
programme.desc: Simon Schama's epic series reaches the 18th century and the birth of modern Britain. Due to an economic explosion, the consumer society is born and agriculture becomes big business. However, many in Scotland are unhappy with the union of the Scottish and English parliaments, and when Bonnie Prince Charlie and his army advance on London, the country's new found peace and prosperity are threatened.

programme.title: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win
programme.desc: Fabio Capello leads Milan to a new era of glory, while Berlusconi steps onto Italy's political stage, ushering in a turbulent new chapter in the nation's politics.

programme.title: Florence Nightingale: Nursing Pioneer
programme.desc: A look at the life of Florence Nightingale, a trailblazer who revolutionised modern nursing. Born into a rich English family, Nightingale broke through social and gender barriers to pioneer a profession previously reserved for men.

programme.title: Dambusters Declassified
programme.desc: Martin Shaw takes a fresh look at one of the most famous war stories of them all. The actor, himself a pilot, takes to the skies to retrace the route of the 1943 raid by 617 Squadron which used bouncing bombs to destroy German dams. He sheds new light on the story as he separates the fact from the myth behind this tale of courage and ingenuity.

programme.title: From Ice to Fire: The Incredible Science of Temperature
programme.desc: Dr Helen Czerski ventures to the bottom of the temperature scale, revealing how cold has shaped the world around us and why frozen doesn't mean what you might think.

programme.title: The Ruth Ellis Files: A Very British Crime Story
programme.desc: In April 1955 Ruth Ellis shot her lover David Blakely dead. It's a case that shocked the nation and it still fascinates today. It has its place in ushering in the defence of diminished responsibility and the abolishment of capital punishment.

programme.title: Roy Clarke Remembers... A Foreign Field
programme.desc: Writer Roy Clarke tells the story of how 'A Foreign Field', his one-off drama telling the story of war veterans returning to the beaches of France, came to life and featured Sir Alec Guinness, Jeanne Moreau and Lauren Bacall.

programme.title: Screen One
programme.desc: Cyril and Amos, two veterans of the Normandy landings, return to France to visit the grave of their wartime friend. They encounter Waldo, an American on a similar mission, and the meeting sparks memories of an old girlfriend from the past. With the mysterious American Lisa in their wake, Cyril and Waldo decide to try to track her down.

programme.title: How to Get Ahead
programme.desc: Stephen Smith explores the flamboyant Baroque court of the Sun King, Louis XIV. Louis created the Palace of Versailles so he could surround himself with aristocrats, artists, interior designers, gardeners, wigmakers, chefs and musicians. Hordes of ambitious courtiers scrambled to get close to the king, but unseemly goings-on in the royal bedchamber reflected the quickest path to power.

programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Pitws Bychain eisiau cyrraedd y llwyn mwyar duon, ond mae wal garreg fawr yn eu hatal. The Wee Littles set out for a blackberry patch, only to find a tall stone wall blocking them.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Fod Parot Methu Cadw Cyfri
programme.desc: There was a time when Parrot was the best keeper of secrets in the whole of Tinga Tinga. In fact, Parrot couldn't open his beak at all. Then one day, some beast dared to steal Lion's mane and Parrot saw the whole thing.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: Pwy fydd y môr-ladron sy'n ymuno â Ben Dant a Cadi i herio'r byd y tro 'ma? From which school will these pirates come, to join Ben Dant and Cadi for a little adventure?

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Sam Spratt takes Siôn out on the Merry Mackerel to catch prawns, but things take a turn for the worse when the mist sets in.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Yn y bennod yma byddwn yn edrych ar y ffyrdd gwahanol y mae pobl yn cyfathrebu gyda'i gilydd. In this episode we'll look at the different ways people use to communicate with each other.

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth yr Orangutan
programme.desc: Mae Gareth yr Orangutan yn teithio ysgolion Cymru yn trafod amryw bynciau. Wythnos yma, Teulu ydi'r pwnc trafod. Gareth the Orangutan is back, and family is the topic of discussion.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Blero goes on a number of adventures with his friends in Ocido. Along the way, Blero learns about a range of fascinating scientific concepts, inventions, natural wonders, and marvels.

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Pam bod pethau'n arnofio?'. Dyna mae Ela am wybod heddiw. Mae gan Tad-cu stori sili arall i'w rannu am bysgod anweledig. Today, Tadcu is on hand to tell a silly story about invisible fish.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, ond pan mae'r gwres canolog yn torri, does neb yn edrych ymlaen i gael person dieithr yn y ty i'w drwsio. An unknown person must visit the house when the central heating system needs repairs.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Cyfres hardd a hilariws yw Help Llaw - un sy'n cofleidio, serennu a dyrchafu Cymry ifanc sydd ag anableddau ac anghenion cyfathrebu.

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Trwyn mawr, trwyn bach, trwyn hir. Ie, Trwyn yw gair arbennig y Cywion Bach heddiw. Big nose, small nose, long nose. Yes, Trwyn (Nose) is the special word today.

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Chief Officer Steel casts Norman in his musical show. Norman causes problems from the first minute - thankfully Fireman Sam is at hand. Steel casts Norman in his new musical!

programme.title: Jambori
programme.desc: Hello and welcome to Jamborî! Come and join Jam on a musical adventure full of interesting sounds and colourful pictures where shadows dance, robots play and fruits move to the music.

programme.title: Digbi Draig
programme.desc: Mae baromedr Abel yn dweud y bydd stormydd eira yn ardal Glenys o'r goedwig. Abel's barometer predicts snowstorms in Glenys's neck of the woods.

programme.title: Jen a Jim a'r Cywiadur
programme.desc: It's a day of coming and going today in Cyw's garden. The eagle has called by with a postcard from Ela the elephant but as the crew read it, the rainbow disappears. Has someone or something taken it?

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Dewch ar antur gyda ni i gwrdd ag anifeiliaid bach y byd. Yn y rhaglen hon cawn gip-olwg ar y chameleon a'r neidr. Taking a close peek at the two animals, the chameleon and the snake.

programme.title: Octonots
programme.sub-title: Yr Octonots a'r Crwbanod Môr Bach
programme.desc: As newborn baby sea turtles make their way to the ocean, the Octonauts must help them avoid predators when a large wave threatens the island where the precious eggs are buried.

programme.title: Sali Mali
programme.desc: Mae Jac Do'n rhoi prawf ar gyfeillgarwch ei ffrindiau drwy fwyta eu cacennau, ac o gael boen bol mae'n dysgu bod rhannu'n beth da! Jac Do tests his friendships by eating his pals' cakes, and when he gets a tummy ache he learns that sharing is good!

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Er nad ydynt yn siarad 'run iaith, mae'r Jetlu a Crwbi'n deall ei gilydd ddigon da i drechu Beti Bowen a'r Cnafon Creulon. The Jetlu and Crubbi unite to defeat Beti Bowen and Cruel Cnafon.

programme.title: Waw!
programme.desc: Mae Awi a'r criw yn edrych mlaen i ddarganfod mwy am Aer. Air is the theme, Awi and the 'Waw' crew are excited to learn more.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Pitws Bychain yn gwehyddu pethau o laswellt hir. Mae Mymryn yn mynd ar goll wrth grwydro. Itsy grows frustrated and gets lost in tall grass, but the others may be able to help.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
